texts.event/poverty-street-production.helpful-: Before the street settles for the night, a nearby stall needs one last crate carried under cover. The work is brief and anonymous.
texts.event/poverty-street-production.neutral-: A shop awning leaves a dry strip of pavement after closing. Nobody offers help and nobody drives you away; for tonight, that is enough.
texts.event/poverty-street-production.pressure: The stones keep the day's cold. You can stay tucked beneath an overhang or keep moving and arrive at morning more exhausted.
texts.event/poverty-cheap-production.shared-qu: The cheap lodging settles early. Thin walls carry every cough and footstep, so the shared room agrees on quiet before anyone starts an argument.
